title: Essential Guides to Data Imports in Business Central
summary: An index post for Business Central developers that points to a series of guides on importing and exporting data with AL. The linked guides cover JSON handling, delimited files, header and detail imports, Excel and multi-tab Excel files, and XML.
key_points: Data import and export are framed as central to onboarding, cross-system sync and keeping records clean
The post itself is a hub that links to separate format-specific guides
Covered formats are JSON, delimited text, Excel including multi-tab workbooks, and XML
One guide focuses on header and detail style imports with AL

quotes.text: Data imports and exports sit at the heart of every successful Business Central implementation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the fundamental importance of data handling to implementation success

quotes.text: Understanding how AL handles these operations gives you a major advantage.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why developers need to master AL data handling patterns and best practices
